command(pwsh -NoProfile -Command "
Get-ChildItem -Path d:\Git_Repositories\Workspace_AI\docs\LCM-Proposal\*.md | ForEach-Object {
    `$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes(`$_.FullName)
    `$hasBom = (`$bytes.Length -ge 3 -and `$bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and `$bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and `$bytes[2] -eq 0xBF)
    `$text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(`$_.FullName)
    `$hasCrLf = `$text.Contains(`"`r`n`")
    `$hasLfOnly = `$text.Replace(`"`r`n`", `"`").Contains(`"`n`")
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Name = `$_.Name
        Length = `$_.Length
        HasBOM = `$hasBom
        HasCRLF = `$hasCrLf
        HasLfOnly = `$hasLfOnly
    }
}
")

command(pwsh -NoProfile -Command "
Get-ChildItem -Path d:\Git_Repositories\Workspace_AI -Recurse | Where-Object { `$_.FullName -notmatch '\\\.git\\' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
")

command(pwsh -NoProfile -Command "
Set-Location d:\Git_Repositories\Workspace_AI

`$allFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File | Where-Object { `$_.FullName -notmatch '\\\.git\\' }

`$audit = foreach (`$f in `$allFiles) {
    `$relPath = `$f.FullName.Replace('d:\Git_Repositories\Workspace_AI\', '')
    `$content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(`$f.FullName)
    `$gcCount = ([regex]::Matches(`$content, 'Workspace_GC', 'IgnoreCase')).Count
    `$reconstructCount = ([regex]::Matches(`$content, 'SystemRekonstruktion|SystemReconstruction|BackupRoot|01_Export|02_Backup|03_Restore|04_Rebuild|90_Setup', 'IgnoreCase')).Count
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Path = `$relPath
        Size = `$f.Length
        Workspace_GC_Refs = `$gcCount
        Crash_Recovery_Refs = `$reconstructCount
    }
}

`$audit | Where-Object { `$_.Workspace_GC_Refs -gt 0 -or `$_.Crash_Recovery_Refs -gt 0 } | Format-Table -AutoSize
")

command(pwsh -NoProfile -Command "
Set-Location d:\Git_Repositories\Workspace_AI

`$files = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File | Where-Object { 
    `$_.FullName -notmatch '\\\.git\\' -and 
    `$_.FullName -notmatch '\\Deletions\\' -and
    `$_.FullName -notmatch '\.log$' -and
    `$_.FullName -notmatch 'WS_DIR\.txt$'
}

`$updated = 0
foreach (`$f in `$files) {
    `$content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(`$f.FullName)
    `$newContent = `$content

    # File and path replacements
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Test-WorkspaceAIReadiness.ps1', 'Test-WorkspaceReadiness.ps1')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Test-WorkspaceAIReadiness', 'Test-WorkspaceReadiness')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('WorkspaceAIQualityGates.psm1', 'WorkspaceQualityGates.psm1')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('WorkspaceAIQualityGates', 'WorkspaceQualityGates')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('AI-Stabilization.json', 'Stabilization.json')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('AI-RealRepoTestPlan.json', 'RealRepoTestPlan.json')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('AI-Proposals.json', 'Proposals.json')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('AI-Proposals.validation.json', 'Proposals.validation.json')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('AI-Stabilization', 'Stabilization')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('AI-RealRepoTestPlan', 'RealRepoTestPlan')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('AI-Proposals', 'Proposals')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Workspace_AI.log', 'Workspace.log')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Workspace_AI.step.log', 'Workspace.step.log')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Workspace_AI.accepted.log', 'Workspace.accepted.log')

    # Function names
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Get-WorkspaceAIRoot', 'Get-WorkspaceRoot')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Resolve-WorkspaceAITargetMethodInstance', 'Resolve-TargetMethodInstance')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Assert-WorkspaceAIIgnoredRepositories', 'Assert-IgnoredRepositories')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Assert-WorkspaceAIStabilizationPolicy', 'Assert-StabilizationPolicy')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Assert-WorkspaceAIRealRepoTestPlan', 'Assert-RealRepoTestPlan')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('Assert-WorkspaceAIStaleAuthorityReferences', 'Assert-StaleAuthorityReferences')

    # Proposal IDs
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('AI-STEP-', 'STEP-')

    # Schema / config types
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('workspace-ai-stabilization-state', 'stabilization-state')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('workspace-ai-real-repository-test-plan', 'real-repository-test-plan')
    `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace('WorkspaceAIStoresTargetDryRunResults', 'WorkspaceStoresTargetDryRunResults')

    if (`$newContent -ne `$content) {
        `$newContent = `$newContent.Replace(`"`r`n`", `"`n`").Replace(`"`n`", `"`r`n`")
        `$utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding(`$false)
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(`$f.FullName, `$newContent, `$utf8NoBom)
        `$updated++
        Write-Host (`"Updated {0}`" -f `$f.FullName.Replace('d:\Git_Repositories\Workspace_AI\', ''))
    }
}

Write-Host (`"Total files updated: {0}`" -f `$updated)
")

# Get commit caab019 / HEAD content with native line breaks

  'Working\Implementation-and-Tooling_BEFORE.md',

foreach (`$f in `$files) {
